name: INEGI DENUE per-state CSV (bulk, no token)
note: EE = 01..32 per state (00 = national, large). ZIP contains conjunto_de_datos/denue_inegi_{EE}_.csv (Latin-1, 42 cols), a data dictionary, and metadata. No token. Redact telefono/correoelec (PII).

name: SAT Listado 69-B (RFC risk list, CSV)
note: Latin-1 CSV with 3 preamble lines before the header (No,RFC,Nombre del Contribuyente,Situación...). Keyed on RFC. Risk overlay; handle individual RFCs/names as personal data.

name: INEGI DENUE query API (needs free token)
note: Optional. The query API needs a free INEGI token. The masiva CSV (above) is preferred for bulk ingestion and needs no token.
